---
title: "VSCode Application"
---

Visual Studio Code has [instructions](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/introvideos/basics) for getting started.

You can download VSCode directly from their [website](https://code.visualstudio.com/download) for your operating system.

Open the downloaded `.dmg` file, drag `Visual Studio Code.app` to the Applications folder, and then open it from there. A pop-up will ask you if you want to open an app downloaded from the internet. Click open.
